title: Great Pyramid as a transmitter

tellings.quote: transmitter okay M of signal whatever they want to whoever they want to talk to

plain: The Great Pyramid of Giza was a transmitter, built to send a signal to whoever its builders wanted to talk to, says a guest named Joe McMoneagle. He offers this to Michels as his own idea, without naming a source, and if he is right the pyramid would be a piece of communications equipment, not a tomb.
